clue.text: Extract marijuana plant

parts.note: to extract is to milk, as in milking a situation or a cow
weed is slang for marijuana

explanation.surface: An instruction to obtain cannabis from the plant itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Milkweed is a North American wildflower with milky sap, the food plant of monarch butterflies.

clue.text: Made English chemical company second, having fished around

indicators.note: around says the word for fished wraps round the company and the second

parts.note: to fish with a rod is to angle, so fished is angled
ICI, Imperial Chemical Industries, was the big British chemical company

explanation.surface: A chemical firm took second place after a spell of fishing and became English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Made English' reads like a verb in the surface story but is the definition; the fishing is the outer word, not the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: To anglicise something is to make it English in form or character, so anglicised is the past tense.

clue.text: Artist set out, climbing out of the centre

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the crossword's usual artist

indicators.note: in a down entry, climbing means the letters read upward, from bottom to top

parts.note: set out, as a table is set out, means laid

explanation.surface: An artist sets off climbing, away from the middle of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Radial describes lines or spokes running outward from a central point, away from the middle.

clue.text: Disease of solvers picked up

indicators.note: picked up as a radio picks up a broadcast: what is heard, not written

parts.note: the clue addresses you, its solvers, so a thing of solvers is yours

explanation.surface: A disease that crossword solvers have caught.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic (southern British) accent YOURS and YAWS sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Yaws is a tropical bacterial infection of the skin and bones, related to syphilis.

clue.text: Composer's rising rank, er, undermined by British media conglomerate

indicators.note: in a down entry, undermined by means the next piece sits beneath
in a down entry, rising means the letters read upward

parts.note: rank, as a smell, means gross
er and um are both noises of hesitation
Sky is the British satellite broadcasting group

explanation.surface: A composer's rising rank is being undercut by a media giant.
explanation.walkthrough: GROSS and UM read upward give MUSSORG, with SKY underneath. The 's stands for 'is', linking definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Modest Mussorgsky was the Russian composer of Pictures at an Exhibition and Boris Godunov.

clue.text: Immediately overwhelmed by alpha male, one in particular from a European capital

definitions.text: one in particular from a European capital

indicators.note: something overwhelmed is engulfed, so these letters are swallowed by the ones around them

parts.note: A is alpha in the NATO alphabet
Ian is a man's name
then can mean at once, immediately afterwards

explanation.surface: An alpha male swamps someone at once, a figure from a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: An Athenian is a native of Athens, the capital of Greece.

clue.text: Top of rock having twelve-inch fissure

indicators.note: in a down entry the top of a word is its first letter

parts.note: twelve inches make one foot, written I (one) and FT (foot)

explanation.surface: A rock summit has a crack a foot long.
explanation.definitionFit: A rift is a crack or split, as in rock or a relationship.

clue.text: Variable, premature annual

parts.note: Y is a variable in algebra
premature means early

explanation.surface: Something changeable and early that happens once a year.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean happening once every year.

clue.text: Old coastal area is excellent, best seen from the east

indicators.note: in an across entry, reading from the east is reading right to left

parts.note: A1 means excellent, written AI with I as one
No 1, number one, means best, written NOI

explanation.surface: An old shoreline region is first-rate, looking its best from the east.
explanation.definitionFit: Ionia was the ancient Greek coastal region of western Asia Minor, now in Turkey.

clue.text: American leave, one taken in an Eastern French region

parts.note: to quit is to leave

indicators.note: taken in means held inside, so the one goes into the letters that follow

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An American takes leave and settles in eastern France.
explanation.walkthrough: Aquitaine is in south-west France, so 'Eastern' belongs to the wordplay, not the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Aquitaine is a historic region of south-western France, once held by English kings.

clue.text: One left outside quietly stopping search, turning back dogs

indicators.note: in an across entry, turning back means reading the result right to left
stopping means plugging, so these letters go into the middle of the search word

parts.note: to search is to seek

indicators.note: outside means the one and the left wrap around the quiet letter

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone left out quietly halts a hunt and turns back with the dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: I and L around P give IPL; that goes inside SEEK to give SEIPLEK, which read backwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Kelpies are Australian sheepdogs, a working breed bred for herding.

clue.text: Retreat from ledge and end, pulling back from both

indicators.note: each of the two words loses its back, its last letter

parts.note: a shelf is a ledge
a term is an end or limit, as in the term of a contract

explanation.surface: A climber retreats from a ledge and an end point, backing away.
explanation.definitionFit: A retreat is a place of safety or refuge, which is what a shelter provides.

clue.text: Famous brand set in stone

parts.note: brand is an old word for a sword; the famous one was set in a stone until the young Arthur pulled it out

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a trademark that will never change; 'brand' here is the poetic word for a sword.
explanation.definitionFit: Excalibur is King Arthur's legendary sword, in one version drawn from a stone to prove his kingship.

clue.text: Plant holder raised on mortar, centrally below block

indicators.note: in a down entry, below means the remaining pieces sit under the block word

parts.note: to bar is to block

indicators.note: in a down entry, on means sitting above the next piece
in a down entry, raised means read upward

parts.note: an owner is the holder of something

indicators.note: centrally picks the middle letters of the word mortar

explanation.surface: A garden plant-holder is raised on mortar beneath a block of stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrenwort, or epimedium, is a woodland perennial once thought to cause sterility.

clue.text: Wherein some early Latin recalled?

indicators.note: recalled read as called back, so the letters run backwards
some means only part of the following words is used

parts.note: the run of letters across these two words

explanation.surface: A question about where early Latin is remembered.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'early Latin' backwards and the answer appears within it, the place where early Latin was spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin began in Latium, in central Italy, so the country is where early Latin lives on.

clue.text: New name given to shooting star moving over weather instrument

indicators.note: in a down entry, over means the first piece sits above the second
new means made afresh, so the word name is remade with a letter shifted
moving means the letters of the star word shift into a new order

parts.note: a shooting star is a meteor

explanation.surface: A shooting star is given a new name as it passes over a weather gauge.
explanation.definitionFit: An anemometer measures wind speed, a standard instrument at a weather station.

clue.text: This will get you free dinners — optimism worked

indicators.note: worked means kneaded or reshaped, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Free dinners can be had if your optimism is worked hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free dinners' looks like one phrase, but 'free' ends the definition and the anagram is of DINNERS and OPTIMISM.
explanation.definitionFit: Disimprisonment is release from prison, the act that sets a captive at liberty.

clue.text: Tramp and Monk joining new border dwellers

parts.note: to tramp is to march
Monk is the setter, so Monk is me

explanation.surface: A tramp and a monk join some new people living on the border.
explanation.walkthrough: Marches are border lands, as in the Welsh Marches between England and Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Marchmen were the inhabitants of the marches, the frontier regions between England and Scotland or Wales.

clue.text: Plant transplants by artery

indicators.note: transplants means moves to new places, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A plant transplants something by way of an artery, like a surgeon.
explanation.definitionFit: The tayberry is a cultivated cross between a blackberry and a raspberry, named after the River Tay.

clue.text: Tree in estate, say, outside England's borders

indicators.note: outside means the car word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: an estate is one kind of car (a station wagon)

indicators.note: borders are the outer edges, the first and last letters of England

explanation.surface: A tree in an estate, perhaps, beyond the English frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: The cedar is a tall coniferous tree, as in the cedar of Lebanon.

clue.text: French president's right answer given in style

indicators.note: given in means placed inside the style word

parts.note: chic means stylishness

explanation.surface: A French president's correct reply is delivered stylishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Jacques Chirac was President of France from 1995 to 2007.

clue.text: Gloomy yet funny linguistic study

indicators.note: funny means odd or peculiar, so the letters come out in an odd order

explanation.surface: Language study is gloomy, yet funny.
explanation.definitionFit: Etymology is the study of where words come from and how their meanings changed.

clue.text: Plant sheath having yellowish-brown area

parts.note: ochre is a yellowish-brown earth colour

explanation.surface: A plant's sheath is coloured yellowish brown over an area.
explanation.definitionFit: An ochrea is a botanical term for the tubular sheath around a stem at the leaf base, as in docks.

clue.text: Judges expelling just who fixed skating event

indicators.note: expelling means throwing out, so the letters of just are removed

parts.note: justices are judges

indicators.note: fixed means rigged or rearranged, so the letters of who are reordered

explanation.surface: Judges throw out a fair-minded person who fixed the result of a skating event.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice show is an entertainment of figure skating performed on a rink.

clue.text: Show bombshell with casing removed

indicators.note: the casing is the outer layer, so the first and last letters are dropped

parts.note: a bombshell, as in blonde bombshell, is a sexpot, a strikingly attractive woman

explanation.surface: A show involving a bomb whose shell has been stripped off.
explanation.definitionFit: An expo is an exhibition, a large public show of products or achievements.

clue.text: Long, drawn vote securing Independent win

indicators.note: securing means holding in place, so the other letters close round the Independent letter

parts.note: to long for something is to ache for it

indicators.note: drawn as a tooth is drawn: the middle letters are pulled out of vote

explanation.surface: A long, tied vote results in an Independent winning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawn' pulls OT out of VOTE to leave VE; ACHE + VE holds I to give the answer. 'Long, drawn' looks like a phrase meaning drawn-out.
explanation.definitionFit: To achieve is to win or attain something through effort.

clue.text: Maple syrup essentially put beneath one

indicators.note: in a down entry, put beneath means the syrup letter goes under the one

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards

indicators.note: essentially means at the essence or heart, the middle letter of syrup

explanation.surface: Maple syrup, at heart, set below something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maple syrup' looks like one item; the definition is 'Maple' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Acer is the botanical genus of the maples, often used as a garden name.

clue.text: On which Spartans perhaps grow replete, possibly after adult pressure

indicators.note: after means the rearranged letters come after the adult and pressure

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
P is the physics abbreviation for pressure

indicators.note: possibly means in some possible arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Spartans might grow full after adult pressure, as if the ancient warriors were bloating.
explanation.walkthrough: Spartan is a variety of eating apple, not a Greek warrior.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartan is a Canadian dessert apple cultivar, so Spartans grow on such a fruit tree.

clue.text: Agreement about hosting overseas ruler

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the letters are read backwards
hosting means holding within, so the answer is inside the word

parts.note: the letters of this word, read backwards

explanation.surface: An agreement involving the hosting of a foreign ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: An emeer, or emir, is a Muslim ruler or prince, especially in the Middle East.
